notablePrerequisites: Opponents can not block Silas Renn.
description:
Cast Time Walk to take an extra turn.
Pay {5}, tap Codex Shredder and sacrifice it to return Time Walk from your graveyard to your hand.
Attack with Silas Renn, dealing combat damage.
Cast Codex Shredder from your graveyard.
Pass the turn.
Repeat.
